svg.font-family: 'LP2P Inter', Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.aria-label: How it works: the browser discovers devices and shows a picker; on first contact the devices pair with a code; the browser asks the user to grant the site access; the page gets an authenticated connection with data channels or WebTransport.
svg.text: The page never sees this list.

text.font-family: 'LP2P Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: Shown on one, typed on the other.
Discovery, pairing and consent happen in trusted browser UI. Trust is kept in a local
trust store, shared by all sites; grants are per site.
